# PK Tax Tools

> Free browser-based estimates and plain-language information about salaried income tax in Pakistan.

PK Tax Tools is an independent website. It is not an official Federal Board of Revenue service and does not provide tax, legal, or financial advice. Calculator results are estimates; confirm applicable rules with the current Finance Act, FBR guidance, or a qualified tax professional.

Salary figures entered into the calculator are processed in the visitor's browser. The tool does not send those figures to a server.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pk-salary-tax-calculator.wwwarsalanali14.workers.dev/): Overview and guidance.
- [Salary calculator](https://pk-salary-tax-calculator.wwwarsalanali14.workers.dev/salary-tax-calculator-pakistan/): Estimates for salaried income in tax year 2026-27, including slab breakdowns, package comparisons, and FAQs.
- [About and editorial policy](https://pk-salary-tax-calculator.wwwarsalanali14.workers.dev/about/): Rate references, update approach, corrections, and limitations.
- [Contact and corrections](https://pk-salary-tax-calculator.wwwarsalanali14.workers.dev/contact/): Report issues through the public GitHub tracker. Do not share private financial details.
- [Privacy policy](https://pk-salary-tax-calculator.wwwarsalanali14.workers.dev/privacy-policy/): Data handling information.
- [Terms of use](https://pk-salary-tax-calculator.wwwarsalanali14.workers.dev/terms/): Terms and limitations.

## Sources

- [Federal Board of Revenue](https://www.fbr.gov.pk/): Official tax information.
- Current and historical rate references are listed on the salary calculator page.
